Robust Magnusson beech wood mallet offers a robust hand tool, ideal for professional joinery and carpentry tasks. Constructed from solid beech wood, the durable mallet offers excellent resistance against splitting, ensuring durability on busy construction sites and in workshops. The ergonomically designed, tapered handle provides a secure and comfortable grip, enhancing control and precision during use. Features a 16oz (0.45kg) head and a hard strike face to deliver effective force for assembly, chiselling, and shaping, without damaging delicate materials. Reliable woodworking mallet suitable for professional toolkits.
